This app is an educational reference. It compiles dosing conventions reported in clinical literature and research communities. It does not provide medical advice, and nothing here is a prescription or a recommendation to use any compound.

Many compounds listed are not approved by the FDA or any regulator, and are sold as research chemicals with no purity, sterility, or dosage oversight. Using them carries real risk.

Always consult a licensed physician before using any peptide, especially if you have a medical condition, take medication, or are pregnant or nursing.

U-100 syringes: 100 units = 1 mL. Example — a 5 mg vial with 2 mL of water gives 2,500 mcg/mL, so a 250 mcg dose is 0.1 mL, drawn to the 10-unit mark.

Units

For body weight and height. Doses stay in mg, mcg and mL — that is how peptides are measured everywhere.

Language

Status labels

ApprovedFDA-approved drug — sometimes for a different use than the popular one.
InvestigationalIn human clinical trials; not yet approved anywhere.
Research onlyNo approval anywhere; sold as an unregulated research chemical.
High cautionMeaningful documented risks beyond the usual unknowns.

Disclaimer

Educational reference only — not medical advice, and no substitute for a physician. Doses shown are conventions reported in clinical literature and research communities, not prescriptions.

Many compounds listed are not FDA-approved and are sold with no purity or sterility oversight. Counterfeits are common. Nothing in this app encourages buying or using any compound.

The tracking tools record only what you enter, and everything stays on this device. If you experience a serious reaction to any substance, seek medical care immediately.
